limitations: No game execution or runtime callback order observation.
Decompiler text can include inlined callees and followed tail calls; references are not all direct caller edges.
A shared native address retains all metadata aliases; a seed label alone does not prove the receiver type.
Raw E8 patterns only corroborate decompiler targets within the selected PE unwind range; instruction boundaries are not independently decoded here.
TypeInfo usage tags and registered fields give static identity/layout, not current runtime values.
Selected static reflected save pipeline; no save-file roundtrip or game execution.
Field policy records selected ES3Reflection guards; runtime TypeIsSerializable, member filters/cache and actual save settings are separate.
Selected attribute constructor prefixes are decoded; argument payloads and unsupported count forms are not generalized.
Constructor defaults require native constructor observations; field default metadata is separate.
Arrays/generic arguments preserve native raw pointers and bytes. Unhandled kinds remain unresolved.
Game types and selected Unity value types are expanded; system collection implementation fields are not save schema.
Static registration resolution does not observe the runtime receiver or MethodInfo instance.
Shared native bodies retain all selected closed generic aliases; native-only labels are analyst assertions.
CodeRegistration is selected by a unique full76-module identity match, not an observed registration call.
No decrypted .sd sample, independent reader/writer or original-engine save/load roundtrip is produced.
RankData, TotalPlayTimeData, other system keys, historical migrations and all Unity custom serializers are outside this declared root graph.

Present-member assignment leaves absent members at their created-object state in this path; parameterless constructor side effects can depend on current global objects, while no-parameterless classes follow a different allocation branch.
Stream wrapper branches do not identify actual save settings or establish that resource-bundle crypto applies to .sd files.

reflection_contract.finding: Fields precede properties; explicit ES3Serializable accepts before later field guards. Safe nonpublic fields otherwise require SerializeField.
ReflectedObjectType constructor eagerly obtains members with safe=true; later settings only initialize an absent member cache.
Writer reads member values and resolves member ES3Type; reader matches property names and assigns through reflected member SetValue.

Registered ReadObject<System.Object> calls CreateInstance before ReadProperties. Ordinary classes with a parameterless constructor use it; without one, the selected CreateInstance branch allocates without calling a business constructor.
Selected Read(key) throws when absent; Read(key,defaultValue) returns the supplied default on its absent-key branch.

LoadoutCustomizeData constructor captures current GameState.PlayerCustomData; SaveCurrentCustomize and ApplyToGameState establish opposite copy directions, with dictionary handling retained in full bodies.
Configured stream path conditionally wraps encryption and compression; actual game save default resource/password and whole-file codec are not recovered by these queries.

scope: Four declared save roots, selected nested graph, ES3 reflection/generic read/write and constructor defaults; static pinned build only.
